scope: Sales conversation context, safe references, sender diagnostics and actionable human review only

production_read_only.configuration_limit: Dashboard project-variable observation, not a reconstructed historical runtime environment or proof about every shared variable.

historical_handoffs.code_behavior: Missing workflow URL returns without remote dispatch. Historical snapshot/URL barrier cannot be distinguished from these persisted rows.

link_metadata.limitation: Original social link targets cannot be recovered from the inspected metadata. No Inbox or arbitrary URL fetch was used.

changes: Read bounded same-channel local context before CTA decisions; Respond history cannot replace locally captured burst fragments.
Preserve visit/human intent when the latest burst fragment is Plis or Este; do not process every fragment.
Use persisted profile context consistently in runner and sender. No post-model CTA replacement.
Resolve only exact HTTPS first-party public listing paths against published inventory before URL sanitization. Persist the catalog FK, not the URL or tracking parameters.
Unresolved links get one alternative question; repeated clarification becomes visible review instead of another link request.
Allow narrow informational confirmations and coordination requests while retaining sensitive-topic and actual appointment/date/time review guards.
Persist current blocked sender outcomes in the existing unique journal. Expired historical runs are not backfilled or resent.
Preserve existing responsible users; require an explicit, validated live unassigned state before a protected workflow effect. Unknown state fails closed.
Reuse open human review, prevent assignment/ACK replay, and never dispatch policy review as automation_fallback.
Expose paginated review and sanitized no-send reasons in the existing admin/gerente_ventas screen; Gerencia de Ventas is the operational queue owner. No new CRM or sending action.

Blocked outcome claimed by another sender still becomes review work.
First-party reference extraction preserves the published FK and discards URL/tracking; foreign/private/redirect URLs are never fetched.
Active admin/manager can read review; advisor denied; pagination retains access to older and fresh jobs.
WhatsApp legacy, OWNER continuity, Legal routing and Administration regressions remain covered by directed suite.

limitations_and_release_gates: NO-GO for deployment until authorized DEV baseline and functional DEV checks are completed and reviewed.
Tests use synthetic model outputs and intercepted Respond transport; this is not proof of a real customer send or actual human attention.
Review is actionable via the existing private manager screen, but operator acknowledgment/closure is not newly implemented or claimed.
Respond provider-side atomicity is not proven. Live reads narrow the race; a separately authorized protected workflow with Manual Assignment exit remains required before connecting a workflow URL.
No historical links or handoff blocking reasons were invented; unresolved social links use bounded clarification/review.
Conversation reconstruction is bounded to 24 hours and 20 local messages plus existing profile/Respond context; it is not an unlimited history replay.
No new schema or migration for this patch. Existing DEV baseline migration remains unapplied pending permission.
No publish, merge, deploy, flag changes, retrospective resends, Respond configuration changes, or changes to PR161/PR163.
